features: Failover Reverse Tunnel Remote Port Rewriting: Rewrites reverse tunnel port mappings during live region failover, ensuring Chisel client requests correct allocated server ports and visitor traffic flows to local machines.
End-to-End Traffic Proxying Verification: Verified traffic forwarding over fallback edge connections to prevent server 502 Bad Gateway responses.
Scoped Session Context Isolation: Client session context is isolated per connection attempt, ensuring heartbeat eviction triggers live failover without exiting the main process.
Central Region Heartbeat Alignment: Central Gateway validates region online status during status heartbeats, returning HTTP 503 for stopped nodes while preserving 200 OK for online edge leases.
Central Control Plane Edge Status Enforcement: Central Gateway responds HTTP 503 Service Unavailable when a region node is disabled or stopped in Portal V2.
Live On-Screen Dynamic Failover: Client CLI dual-pings Central Gateway heartbeat, detecting node stops within 5s and switching regions live without CLI restarts.
Instant Heartbeat Lease Eviction Detection: Updated client background status heartbeat loop to inspect HTTP status codes, detecting lease evictions and node shutdowns within 5 seconds.
Seamless Region Failover: Automatically triggers region re-probing and reconnects to the next fastest online edge node, updating TUI headers, system logs, and local state files in real time.
Client TUI Render Cleanup: Updated all section headers and divider lines to erase to end-of-line (\033[K), eliminating trailing character artifacts.
Inspector Replay Sanitization: Sanitized HTTP method strings during request replay, fixing net/http invalid method errors when replaying previously replayed requests.

Dynamic Region Auto-Failover on Node Shutdown: Set Chisel retry limits and added an outer failover loop so the client CLI automatically auto-detects edge node shutdowns and fails over to the next fastest online region.
